summary: BACK ON MARKET - SOUGHT AFTER AREA - EARLY VIEWING ESSENTIAL Located in the heart of the ever desirable West End of Darlington, this three bedroom semi detached family home is immaculately presented throughout and offers most spacious living accommodation.
description:
ENTRANCE HALLWAY Welcoming hallway with oak parque flooring, radiator, stairs access to the first floor, built in under stair storage cupboard, inset ceiling spotlights.

LIVING ROOM With upvc framed double glazed bay style window to the frontage with radiator beneath.

OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / DINING AREA/FAMILY ROOM A spacious, light and airy room which is currently being utilised as a second reception / family room. To the family room area there is oak parque flooring, bifold doors which allows for most natural lighting and open onto the rear garden area, inset ceiling spotlights. To the Kitchen area there is a range of modern cream hi gloss base and wall units, work surfaces with tiling to splash and work areas, inset sink unit with mixer tap and drainer, integrated oven and hob with overhead stainless steel extractor unit, space for a dining table and chairs, plumbing for the automatic washing machine, two velux skylights to again allow for natural lighting, upvc framed double glazed window.

GROUND FLOOR WC With a fitted white suite comprising of; hand wash basin into vanity, wc, tiling to splash and vanity areas, radiator, extractor fan.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

With upvc framed double glazed window.

BEDROOM ONE

Situated to the frontage with upvc framed bay style window with radiator beneath.

BEDROOM TWO Situated to the rear with upvc framed double glazed window, radiator, range of fitted robes.

BEDROOM THREE With, upvc framed double glazed window to the frontage, radiator.

FAMILY BATHROOM Fitted with a white suite and contemporary black fittings, comprising of; panel bath hand wash basing set into vanity, shower cubicle with inset rainhead shower, wc, fully tiled walls, wall mounted radiator, inset ceiling spotlights, upvc framed double glazed window.

EXTERNALLY To the frontage there is a garden area which is laid to gravel for easy maintenance, driveway which leads onto the garage, side access which leads onto the rear garden area which is laid to lawn with paved border and patio area.
